nt: NT is an organization concerned to preserve historic monuments and buildings and places of historical interest or natural beauty.
NT means the same as National Trust.
ntis: NTIS is an agency in the Technology Administration that is a primary resource for government-funded scientific and technical and engineering and business related information.
NTIS means the same as National Technical Information Service.
nth: Nth means last or greatest in an indefinitely large series.
Nth means the same as n-th.
